meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按6个阶段执行代码重构：先确认意图，再分析代码库、构建依赖图、评估测试覆盖、生成详细计划，然后逐步执行并每步验证，最后全面回归测试。
howto.when: 当你提到“refactor”、“重构”、“清理”、“简化”等关键词，或要求对文件、模块、项目进行代码重组时触发。

say.note: Claude 会分析该文件并执行安全重构。

say.text: 重构 AuthService 类，提取验证逻辑
say.note: Claude 会定位类并生成计划后执行。

say.text: 清理所有使用已弃用API的函数
say.note: Claude 会搜索并替换为推荐实现。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude performs code refactoring in 6 phases: intent clarification, codebase analysis, dependency mapping, test coverage assessment, detailed plan generation, step-by-step execution with verification, and final regression testing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "refactor", "cleanup", "simplify", or request code restructuring on a file, module, or project.

say_en.note: Claude analyzes and refactors the file safely.

say_en.text: Refactor AuthService class, extract validation logic
say_en.note: Claude locates the class and executes after planning.

say_en.text: Clean up all functions using deprecated API
say_en.note: Claude searches and replaces with recommended implementations.
